meta.title: Dream Skin (dsh-dream-skin)
meta.description: Native theme skins: 8 themes, diffused-light wallpapers, per-skin accent color — switch with one click (restart DSH after install)

en.accent.hint: Set a custom accent color for the active skin (an override layer — the skin itself is untouched). Reset to return to the skin's default accent.
en.accent.title: Accent
en.background.hint: The image shows through the translucent main canvas and sidebar; inner surfaces stay opaque for readability
en.background.sidebarLink: Link sidebar transparency to the wallpaper (turn off to control it separately)
en.background.sidebarOpacityHint: Dragging this slider turns the wallpaper link off and controls the sidebar on its own
en.background.title: Wallpaper
en.bg2.refresh: Auto refresh (re-fetch this link on a schedule — great for daily wallpaper APIs)
en.bg2.refreshUrlOnly: Scheduled refresh only works with Image URL wallpapers — pick “Image URL” above first
en.bg2.title: Advanced Wallpaper (URL / gradient)
en.bg2.urlEmpty: No image link yet: this tab paints no background, so the page stays as it is. Paste a link and press Apply.
en.bg2.urlInvalid: Unsupported link — only http/https or data:image image URLs are supported
en.bg2.urlLoadFailed: Failed to load the image — please check the link
en.composer.hint: Slide right for a more see-through input box; slide left for a more solid one with crisper text.
en.glass.help: Transparency sliders: right = more see-through, left = more solid (crisper text). The blur slider drives both the wallpaper and every glass surface. Materials (frosted / liquid) only switch the glass character — they never move any slider value.
en.glass.title: Glass effect
en.material.frosted.desc: Classic frost: milky texture, crisper text
en.material.hint: Materials only switch the glass character (frosted = milky frost, liquid = glossy refraction) — no slider value ever changes; transparency and blur always follow your manual settings.
en.material.liquid.desc: Clearer and glossier, with stronger refraction
en.modal.hint: Controls how see-through dropdown menus / overlays / popups are — slide right to let the content behind show through, left to keep text crisp. The readability floor only applies while a wallpaper is on screen: the wash puts page content behind these faces, so surfaces painted from the popup-base token (Settings, the plugin manager, trajectory tooltips, floating cards, and others) AND the question / approval / plan-review cards hold at 92% opacity, and the transparent end of this slider stops affecting them — the value then shows an "at the 92% floor" note. With no wallpaper the backdrop is already opaque, so the slider keeps its full 0–100% range. Dropdown menus and the scrim are never under the floor; they always keep the full range.
en.modal.title: Popup transparency
en.packs.empty: No packs yet. Import a JSON theme pack, or pick a built-in skin from the Skins row.
en.packs.shareUnavailable: A built-in appearance (Default/light/dark) is active — nothing to share. Pick a skin or theme pack above first.
en.packs.title: Theme Packs (local)
en.skin.title: Skins
en.storage.hint: Some settings could not be saved to local storage (quota full, or the browser is in private mode). They still apply in this session but may revert after a restart.
